Fix every surface: word the checks by result ('One row shows 6 students and 4 known cities'; 'The four figures come from the known fees only'), make Activity 3 hint 1 a reasoning step (which function gives a total, an average, a smallest, a largest), and reword At work without the method. Also remove the method from the editor alt/static text, the topic.js fallback and artifact.md where they name the functions (the Activity 3 alt and static exercise say 'using SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX of fee'). Fix this together with C2E-AGG-02, which changes the Activity 3 task, so the new check wording follows the new task. [round 1, 8a7daa17] Verified. Every unreadable statement, the empty-file prompt and every real subset limit reach the shell as kind 'limit' from the adapter's check() in authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/page-build/engine.js; I reproduced 'SELEC * FROM students;', a missing comma between two VALUES rows, a missing semicolon before a second SELECT and the untouched starter, all kind 'limit'. authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/page-build/controller.js relabels 'limit' as 'Not in this practice editor', and LIMITS item 4 in authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/page-build/build.mjs plus every page's Sources footer ('not as invalid PostgreSQL') say that label never means the SQL is wrong. The label is page-owned, so it is fixable in scope. Acceptable fix: in controller.js, wrap EDITOR.check (EDITOR is Object.create of the adapter) and re-kind problems by message into three classes. Real subset limits (WITH, psql meta-commands, CREATE TABLE and so on) keep 'Not in this practice editor'. Unreadable statements ('could not read the statement near', 'could not read one starting') get a learner label such as 'Check your SQL'. The empty-file prompt gets its own neutral label. Message matching is feasible: I checked that real limits carry their own messages ('WITH queries are outside this practice editor', 'CREATE is not available here', 'Transactions are outside this practice editor', 'COPY runs on the database server', and the psql meta-command text), distinct from the unreadable-statement messages. Never use the adapter's own 'Lesson check' (B4), and never use kind 'hint', because the shell blocks Run only on non-hint problems. Run gating, the 'limit' notRun status and onSqlRun's 'did not use up a try' path must stay exactly as they are (E2 is pending). Reword LIMITS item 4 and the footer sentence in each src/<topic>.body.html and artifact.md to match. The minimum acceptable fix, if message matching seems too brittle, is one neutral label covering both cases, with LIMITS and footer sentences that no longer say the SQL is fine. Shell wording stays a recipe finding.

The authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/page-build/build.mjs badge reads 'Practice editor: follows PostgreSQL on this page's sample tables' and the status span reads 'SQL practice editor'. The shell's empty Problems text is 'No problems found by the lesson checker', which also uses B4 grader vocabulary. C2 F5 says a page never says both 'not real' and 'PostgreSQL rejected'. [round 1, 8a7daa17] Reproduced at 570x1000 under file:// and over http://127.0.0.1: scrollY 157, exactly the top of #activity-1. At 1280 px it is 121 on inner-and-left-joins and 0 where the document fits. Cause confirmed: with history.replaceState stubbed out, scrollY stays 0. The last line of authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/page-build/controller.js calls go(...,'replace'), whose history.replaceState(#activity-1) runs during parsing. It does not throw, and the browser's load-time scroll-to-fragment then scrolls to #activity-1, so F1 fails on the narrow frame (G7). Fix in controller.js: on first load with no #activity-N in the URL, do not write a hash (call go with no history mode), or write it after load and keep scroll at 0. Keep the hash behaviour for later navigation. Measured in headless Chromium only; check the platform embed after the fix.
